collection.title: SEAT Altea XL MPV 2006 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The SEAT Altea XL MPV 2006 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Claw Wiper arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Altea, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
